verdict.rationale: Aleph documents several first-party AI insight features. Scan is an AI analyst that runs flux and variance analysis with commentary on what changed and why, suggests interesting dimensions, and says so when it finds nothing rather than hallucinating. Aleph Agent reasons over cross-system data, returns cited answers, and can build or update reports and dashboards, while mapping agents generate suggestions for approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, since all evidence is vendor marketing.
